googleAccessRemoval.contentDeletionNotice: Paperclip then deletes what agents read from Google through it: saved tool results and the transcripts of runs that used it. This starts at once. Paperclip waits for runs that are still working, and keeps trying until every step succeeds. Comments, documents and files that agents wrote into tasks stay.

cloudFormation.title: With CloudFormation
cloudFormation.readOnlyTemplate: It is made for this connection, so it needs no edits.
cloudFormation.fullTemplate: It is made for this connection; it only needs the access policy you choose in step 3.
cloudFormation.openRest: in the AWS account agents should use, create a stack, choose Upload a template file, and select the downloaded file.
